description:
Take a pen and sit quietly and allow your mind the space and time to think.  You have answers for powerful change within you but you may rarely make the time to listen.

Now is that time. Be gentle with these questions, they can be quite triggering and need some kindness and compassion when exploring. ❤️
Let me know in the comments which prompt stood out for you? 

Why is it more important for me to unhappy than happy? 

What do I truly want in life?

Who or where did I learn that I wasn’t good enough and that I can’t have what I truly want?
.
How am I complicit in creating the conditions in life I say I don’t want?
.
What am I tolerating in life right now and why?
.
What am I truly frightened of?
.
If you would like some journal prompts to build self esteem and confidence, put yes please in the comments. 🤗. Prompt 4 credited to Jerry Colonna.
.
These are tough questions which are going to take some investment of time in exploring, but do make the time as most people won’t.  If you would like to explore your answers or why you are self sabotaging or being blocked from living the life you truly want then please do reach out for coaching. My link is in the bio. 

(Update!  The confidence boosting journal prompts are on my page ready for you to upgrade your mind with. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️) 

#mindsetchange #selfcare #selfsabotage #successmindset #mindfulness #journalinspiration #journalprompts #spiritual #manifesting #anxiety #overthinking #procrastination
